# Romanization effect (generated by romanization.py)

Parity vs English on the same 1012 parallel sentences, native script vs
chat-style romanization (IAST, diacritics stripped, lowercased, danda->'.',
candra vowels mapped). residual = source-script letters surviving
transliteration (codepoints / lines affected), a coverage check:

| lang | gpt2 native | gpt2 romanized | o200k native | o200k romanized | residual |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| hin | **7.42x** | **2.25x** | **1.57x** | **1.87x** | 0 cp / 0 lines |
| mar | **7.86x** | **2.29x** | **1.82x** | **1.93x** | 0 cp / 0 lines |
| ben | **9.61x** | **2.25x** | **1.71x** | **1.87x** | 0 cp / 0 lines |
| kan | **13.59x** | **2.35x** | **1.97x** | **1.96x** | 0 cp / 0 lines |
| tam | **15.54x** | **3.09x** | **1.98x** | **2.69x** | 0 cp / 0 lines |
| tel | **12.97x** | **2.20x** | **1.93x** | **1.84x** | 0 cp / 0 lines |

probe (docstring example, actual output): मुझे थोड़ा पानी चाहिए। -> `mujhe thora pani cahie.`

**Tamil artifact bound**: sanscript invents aspirates Tamil script cannot
express; fully de-aspirated lower bound: gpt2 **2.37x**, o200k **2.03x** (real Tanglish keeps some th/dh, so it lies between the bound and the table row).

**Organic-spelling direction (hin probe)**: applying attested Hinglish
conventions (word-final schwa deletion, c->ch, v->w) on top of the scheme:
gpt2 2.11x, o200k 1.76x — i.e. organic
spelling is CHEAPER than the clean scheme, and hin o200k stays above its
native 1.57x.
